regent_preparations.speaker: serene
regent_preparations.text: They're here. Caelan, would you meet them by the lower bridge? Bring them in when they're ready.

regent_arrival.speaker: caelan
regent_arrival.text: Regent Aldric? Mother Serene sent me. I’m Caelan.

regent_arrival.speaker: aldric
regent_arrival.text: Thank you, Caelan. Have we kept her waiting?

regent_arrival.speaker: caelan
regent_arrival.text: We’ve just finished setting the table.

regent_arrival.speaker: aldric
regent_arrival.text: Then we’ve arrived at a very good moment.

regent_arrival.speaker: aldric
regent_arrival.text: *glances back with a tired smile* Yes. I heard that.

regent_arrival.speaker: aldric
regent_arrival.text: This is Lucan Rooke, my guard. Lucan, Caelan is showing us in.

regent_arrival.speaker: caelan
regent_arrival.text: Yes. Then through the hall to the dining room.

regent_arrival.speaker: caelan
regent_arrival.text: Mira made it. She gave it to me this morning.

regent_arrival.speaker: lucan
regent_arrival.text: Keep it clear of the gatepost. You’re wearing it wider than you think.

regent_clerk_waiting.speaker: regent_clerk
regent_clerk_waiting.text: I’ll wait until his lordship has finished.

regent_welcome.speaker: serene
regent_welcome.text: You look as though you could use something warm.

regent_welcome.speaker: aldric
regent_welcome.text: I could use several things. That’s comfortably first.

regent_welcome.speaker: serene
regent_welcome.text: Caelan, would you pass the bread?

regent_welcome.speaker: tomas
regent_welcome.text: Were you working the brake coming down the ridge?

regent_welcome.speaker: tomas
regent_welcome.text: How do you stop the wagon getting ahead of the horses?

regent_welcome.speaker: regent_driver
regent_welcome.text: Keep it slow before it starts. Once a loaded wagon’s running, you’ve left yourself very little to work with.

regent_welcome.speaker: tomas
regent_welcome.text: Does the brake press against both wheels?

regent_welcome.speaker: caelan
regent_welcome.text: *slides the bread toward him* You were going to make sure everyone remembered to eat.

regent_welcome.speaker: tomas
regent_welcome.text: I can ask while I’m eating.

regent_welcome.speaker: lucan
regent_welcome.text: His lordship chose me because I can manage both.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: Before I lose you to the festival preparations, could we look at the ridge survey?

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: Of course. Caelan, let me move those plates.

regent_discussion.speaker: caelan
regent_discussion.text: I’ve got them.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: The surveyors marked the nearer seam here. They believe it could supply stone for several of the repair crews.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: What’s coming from the existing quarries?

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: More is being cut. Much of it is already promised, and the longer journeys keep tying up the same carts.

regent_discussion.speaker: tomas
regent_discussion.text: Couldn’t the crown send more?

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: I’ve asked.

regent_discussion.speaker: tomas
regent_discussion.text: I thought being the monarch’s brother would make that part quicker.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: People haven’t been refusing me, Tomas. They still have to cut the stone and bring it. There are other communities waiting for the same loads.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: A nearer source would give us more room to work. The proposed face is clear of the standing sanctuary walls.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: The protected ground extends beyond those walls.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: I know. I believe we can preserve the place while working the seam. I wouldn’t have brought you the proposal otherwise.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: Aether gathers there naturally. People have cared for that place for generations. They tend the grove in remembrance of those they’ve lost.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: The sanctuary buildings are part of that keeping. So are the trees, and the ground beneath them.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: Then the plan needs to account for all of it.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: Yes. And there is still a great deal we cannot account for.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: These foundations continue into the hillside. The plan never shows where they end.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: My engineer could supervise a shallow trial, away from the marked walls. If we encounter masonry, we stop.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: We would already have opened the ground by then.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: That is how we establish what is there.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: Ordinarily, yes. But there’s an account I want your engineer to read first.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: Workers opened a passage beneath the sanctuary. A discharge injured them. They closed the passage again.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: *reads for a moment* Did they find what caused it?

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: They left no explanation.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: Could it have anything to do with the recent lightning?

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: I can’t tell you that. This account is much older.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: Then we need someone to examine the site.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: We do. Your engineer and I can walk it together. Inspect the surface, compare it with the plan, and see what further records we can obtain.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: And the trial cut?

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: I can agree to the inspection. I cannot endorse opening the ground yet.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: Take the stone we set aside for the courtyard repairs.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: You still need that work done.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: We can put it off. I’ll arrange meals for the crew as well.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: *his expression softens* Thank you. That will help.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: But it won’t be enough.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: No.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: I know.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: I’ll have my engineer speak with you. Please send for the records.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: I will.

regent_discussion.speaker: aldric
regent_discussion.text: And when we’ve done the inspection, we’ll need to discuss the seam again.

regent_discussion.speaker: serene
regent_discussion.text: Yes.

regent_aftermath.speaker: caelan
regent_aftermath.text: *quietly* He looked relieved when you offered the stone.

regent_aftermath.speaker: serene
regent_aftermath.text: There are people waiting for it.

regent_aftermath.speaker: caelan
regent_aftermath.text: I thought that might settle things for a while.

regent_aftermath.speaker: serene
regent_aftermath.text: It settles what we can give him today.

regent_aftermath.speaker: caelan
regent_aftermath.text: And he’ll ask about the quarry again.

regent_aftermath.speaker: tomas
regent_aftermath.text: Caelan? When you’re finished, can you come and look at the lanterns?

regent_aftermath.speaker: tomas
regent_aftermath.text: Nothing. I want to show you.

regent_aftermath.speaker: serene
regent_aftermath.text: Go on. I have a letter to write.
